For young readers and their grown-ups

Side Hustle Junior

Jeffrey L. Carrier

On a Saturday afternoon, Maya drew twelve cats with tiny crowns, packaged them as a digital sticker set, priced it at $4, and went to sleep. By Sunday night, eleven strangers had bought it. She made $44 from a device she already owned, using a free app she had downloaded to doodle.

Read more

That is what this book teaches.

Side Hustle Jr.: Your Guide to Earning Online is the complete, step-by-step guide for kids ages 10 to 14 who want to start earning money online, not someday, but this week, with tools they can download for free today.

No prior experience required. No startup money. No business license. No expensive software. Just a skill, a device, and the specific steps to turn what you already know how to do into something someone else will pay for.

Seven complete earning paths, one for every type of creator:

• Digital art and sticker packs, sell illustrations, sticker sets, and custom avatars on Etsy and Gumroad

• Websites and blogs, build a site around something you love and grow an audience that pays

• Ebooks, write and sell short guides on topics you already know well

• Print on demand, put your designs on T-shirts, mugs, posters, and phone cases without holding any inventory

• Online courses and video tutorials, teach a skill on video and sell it as a digital product

• Canva and Notion templates, build reusable design and productivity tools others will buy

• Study tools and educational resources, make flashcards, worksheets, and printables teachers and students actually need

Each chapter follows a named kid character through a real challenge, and solves it in a way you can replicate. Every chapter ends with a TRY THIS exercise designed to get you from reading to doing in under an hour.

Also inside:

• The Spend/Save/Reinvest framework for managing your first earnings

• Online safety essentials every kid entrepreneur needs to know

• Time management strategies for building a business alongside school

• How to market your work without a budget or a big following

• What to do when things go wrong, and how to recover fast

• Copyright basics, digital footprint awareness, and reputation protection

• A step-by-step project plan: build, test, improve, and launch

• Platform age requirements, a full glossary, and a guide for parents and educators

This is not a simplified version of adult business advice. Every chapter is honest about the effort required, and specific about exactly what to do next. Readers do not need to finish the book before they start. The structure is built for action.

About the Kids Future Fund

A portion of proceeds from this book supports the Kids Future Fund, a program that provides free entrepreneurship education for young creators who would not otherwise have access to it. Learn more at kidsfuturefund.org.

Side Hustle Jr. is the first book in a series. Forthcoming titles include Side Hustle Jr.: Advanced Earning, Side Hustle Jr.: Managing Your Money, and Side Hustle Jr.: Creator's Playbook.
